build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance with model, optimizer, data reader, and validation config to train an ML model
implement_TrainUnit: implement a TrainUnit subclass with process_batch and prepare_metric_bag methods to define custom training logic
run_Trainer: run the Trainer to execute the full training loop with checkpointing, validation, and metric recording
register_Trainer_checkpoint_hook: register a checkpoint save hook callback on the Trainer to run custom logic after each checkpoint is saved
request_Trainer_stop: request the Trainer to gracefully stop training at the end of the current step
